title: UzEngine Import Sidecar
description: UzEngine import sidecar file (.uzimport) — metadata tracking the import history of a source asset. Stored alongside the source file (e.g., 'shader.hlsl.uzimport'). Used by the cook pipeline to skip up-to-date assets (content-addressed via xxHash64).

importer.description: Name of the importer that produced this sidecar (e.g., 'shader', 'texture', 'mesh', 'audio').

version.description: Importer version at the time of import. When the importer version increases, a reimport is triggered.

source_hash.description: xxHash64 hex digest (16 lowercase hex chars) of the source file content. Changed hash triggers reimport.

options.description: Import options used during this import. Preserved for deterministic reimport.

outputs.description: Map of variant name to cached output file path. Each variant is a different compilation target (e.g., shader model, platform).

additionalProperties.description: Absolute or relative path to the cached compiled output file.

dependencies.description: Paths of files this asset depends on (e.g., included shader headers). A change in any dependency triggers reimport.
